commit/developer.cause: push uploads every op and object reachable from the pushed heads, and the server re-ingests and re-verifies all of it; the client also re-verifies the whole history on open. On medium and stress the server root cannot be seeded within 30 minutes, because every land runs conflicts() (THA-21).
commit/developer.evidence: Profile at 3d06d3b (bun --cpu-prof, KVM dev host): small-serial: client OpLog.load 36%; server during the push: ingestBundle 19%, verifyCapability 19%, listGrants 12%; e2e.push.100 is only ~0.5 s slower than e2e.push.10 in this profile run

checkout/developer.cause: thaddeus workspace pulls the branch into the shared store that already holds it, re-ingesting and re-verifying the branch's whole history before writing the files. Medium and stress cannot be seeded (THA-21).
checkout/developer.evidence: Profile at 3d06d3b (bun --cpu-prof, KVM dev host): small-serial: verifyOp 34%, Store.ingest 27%, Identity.fromDid 24%

pull/developer.cause: pull re-fetches and re-verifies the head chain and the operation closure instead of the ops the copy lacks. Medium and stress cannot be seeded (THA-21).
pull/developer.evidence: Profile at 3d06d3b (bun --cpu-prof, KVM dev host): small-serial: Store.ingest 33%, verifyCapability 31%, verifyOp 30%, Identity.fromDid 29%

ci-checkout/ci.cause: clone fetches and verifies the whole history, while a CI job needs one revision (git clones depth 1).
ci-checkout/ci.evidence: Profile at 3d06d3b (bun --cpu-prof, KVM dev host): small-serial: Store.ingest 27%, verifyOp 24%, Identity.fromDid 22%, verifyCapability 20%
